title: Hinomori Shizuku — The Same Dango As That Day〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Card: The Same Dango As That Day（4★）

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, Shizuku, we'll leave the planning for our moon viewing stream up to you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Good luck!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you, I promise to do my best!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
We're really doing a moon viewing...
I've never had many opportunities to actually do one, so I can't wait!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, you haven't?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Well, I've made dango with my family before, but we never really did much more than that...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, I see.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We usually just bought a bunch of traditional sweets and made an event out of it, so that was usually pretty fun.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: After I started learning how to cook, my dad, big sister and I began making dango from scratch.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, that's so cool!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You really are an incredible cook, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. If you want any help with dango dishes, just ask me!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm sure you'll get that chance to show us your skills.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, they're going to be invaluable!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Do either of you have any nice moon viewing memories, Haruka, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm in the same boat as Minori, so I can't say that I do.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: However, I've sort of celebrated through some segments of TV programs and events where I interacted with my fans.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I remember watching those!!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But in terms of normal moon viewings, I didn't do much other than trying to see the rabbit on the moon when I was little...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, Shii and I also used to do that when we were little!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I even remember Shii trying to stretch up as high as she could to feed some dango to the rabbit on the moon.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: She even kept wondering if they were eating dango like we were during our moon viewing parties, so she seems to value them quite a lot...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haha. That's so cute of her!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, she really is!
I wish I could just show you...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, okay, maybe later.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But what about you, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Me? Well...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: One time, during this moon viewing party we had during kindergarten, I made rabbit-shaped dango with Shii.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Rabbit-shaped dango?
That sounds adorable!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, they turned out very well.
Shii was actually the one who showed me how to make them.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She showed you?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, we started out in different groups, but we ended up making them together...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Unfortunately, some of the other children kept telling her that she should follow the teachers' instructions.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, it's pretty natural to believe everything grown-ups say when you're little, but your sister's so creative!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: She really is. Which is why I wanted her to make her dango just the way she likes.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Sadly, she ended up all alone and I drifted back towards her without even thinking about it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That was when I asked her if we could make them together.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. That's so adorable♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, it really is! You can even tell how Shiho's personality hasn't changed since she was little!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, she's still a bit of a lone wolf, but she's always been a very strong individual.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, uh... It's nothing.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Anyway, thank you all so much!
It was so nice to hear about all of your wonderful memories♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, this was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It might even be nice to talk about these experiences for one of your streams♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right...!
It's not every day that you get to hear about what an idol was like when they were little...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I wanna hear more and more about what you were like, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Can't you just ask her yourself?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
But I see what you mean...
It doesn't have to be just us either. We can ask our fans about their childhoods too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, that's a good idea. We can make an event out of it through the comments sections.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, we've pretty much got this one in the bag!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, and thanks to all of you, I have a feeling that it'll go over very well with everyone...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (It's unfortunate that I won't get to do a moon viewing with Shii...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But our childhood memories may just come in handy for this stream.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I have to keep doing everything I can for our viewers on the other side of the camera...)
